title: The Scenario of the Steaming Locked Room
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Professor Agasa, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Haibara, Inspector Yokomizo) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Discrepancies vs. the old lower-fidelity cases/ file: (1) the old file's event e1 says 'Tanzawa, disguised as Tetsuyama, tricks... Tetsuyama into hiding in the women's bath' -- this conflates two separate beats. The transcript actually has Tanzawa deceive Tetsuyama by PHONE the night before (falsely relaying that Natori Mishio would bathe there at dawn, so Tetsuyama should hide overnight to spy on her); the disguise (knit cap, glasses, towel-as-scarf, imitated limp) is a *separate* trick used the next morning so Tanzawa could walk through the bridge entrance impersonating Tetsuyama and re-enter the crime scene, not the mechanism that lured Tetsuyama into hiding. (2) the old file leaves Tanzawa's motive as 'unspecified (not stated in the available source excerpt)' -- the transcript states it plainly: Tetsuyama stripped Tanzawa of the lead 'middle-aged hitman' role in the Scarlet Wellspring remake five years earlier, ending his acting career and pushing him into managing Natori instead; when the remake was greenlit again Tetsuyama (drunk) didn't even recognize Tanzawa's voice on the phone begging for the role back. (3) the old file's clue c2 ('only the culprit could know no adult woman was inside') doesn't match the transcript's actual slip -- the real tell is Tanzawa (voicing Agasa's bowtie translator) blurting that he 'saw nothing but your butt', guilty knowledge of the children's presence in the women's bath that only someone who had actually been inside could have. The culprit identification itself (Tanzawa) matches the old file. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Tanzawa's ring is blackened by silver sulfide, evidence of long sulfur-spring exposure that contradicts his claim of only just having arrived at the bath.
Right-handed Tanzawa pressed the vending machine button left-handed and called Conan 'runt' at 4:30am -- both quirks belong to left-handed, pipe-smoking Tetsuyama, not to Tanzawa.

Voicing Agasa's translator bowtie, Tanzawa blurts that he 'saw nothing but your butt' -- guilty knowledge of the children's presence in the women's bath that only someone who had actually been inside could have.
